column8: Take the Disengage or Dash action as a Bonus Action; your jump distance is doubled.
Regain hit points equal to 1d10 + your fighter level.
Take one additional action on your turn.
On your turn, you can enter a rage as a bonus action.
Use your action to magically assume the shape of a beast that you have seen before.
Touch yourself and restore hit points from the pool, up to the amount remaining in it.

column4: note:Restore that many hit points to the creature you touch
column8: Touch a creature and restore hit points to it from the pool, up to the amount remaining in it.

column4: note:Cure one disease or neutralize one poison affecting the creature you touch
column8: Expend 5 hit points from the pool to cure the target of one disease or neutralize one poison affecting it.

column4: note:Each undead within 30 feet that sees or hears you makes a Wisdom save or is turned for 1 minute
column8: Each undead that can see or hear you within 30 feet must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure it is turned for 1 minute or until it takes any damage.

column4: note:Divide five times your cleric level in hit points among creatures within 30 feet, none above half its maximum
column8: Restore hit points equal to five times your cleric level, divided among creatures within 30 feet. A creature is restored to no more than half its hit point maximum, and not an undead or a construct.

column4: note:For 1 minute add your Charisma modifier (minimum +1) to attack rolls with the weapon you hold
column8: For 1 minute, add your Charisma modifier (minimum +1) to attack rolls with one weapon you are holding. It sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and is magical for the duration.

column4: note:Each fiend or undead within 30 feet that sees or hears you makes a Wisdom save or is turned for 1 minute
column8: Each fiend or undead that can see or hear you within 30 feet must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure it is turned for 1 minute or until it takes damage.

column4: note:The creature you hit makes a Constitution save or is stunned until the end of your next turn
column8: When you hit another creature with a melee weapon attack, spend 1 ki point. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of your next turn.
Transform 2 sorcery points into one spell slot of level 1. It vanishes when you finish a long rest.

Transform 5 sorcery points into one spell slot of level 3. It vanishes when you finish a long rest.
Transform 6 sorcery points into one spell slot of level 4. It vanishes when you finish a long rest.
Transform 7 sorcery points into one spell slot of level 5. It vanishes when you finish a long rest.

column4: note:Until the end of your next turn you know where any celestial, fiend or undead within 60 feet is
column8: As an action, you open your awareness: until the end of your next turn you know the location of any celestial, fiend, or undead within 60 feet of you that is not behind total cover, and of any place or object within the same radius that has been consecrated or desecrated.
